contract.title: Audit frozen seed 11 and seed 19 package design
contract.goal: Starting from exact commit 98d9092751abd84a3d3ad6b39e932e5e501740c0, audit and specify the exact field-level mapping for revision 4 candidate artifacts for two separate matrix experiments: EXP-20260825-ISL-BANDWIDTH-CONFIRM-S11 and EXP-20260825-ISL-BANDWIDTH-CONFIRM-S19. Each must contain exactly b5 then b2 for only its own trace seed. Preserve every R03 scenario, demand, access, topology, routing, timing, bandwidth and pressure threshold invariant; only identifiers and trace_seed may differ. Specify one R04 brief binding both packages and separate pressure decision contracts for S11 and S19. Do not edit files, execute shell/compiler/tests, or create reviews, decision.json, finalization.json, authorization.json, results, or implementation-code changes. The brief must state: seeds 11/19 were selected after seeing seed 7 but before generating or viewing their scenario results; S19 remains frozen but unauthorized until S11 is exactly PRESSURE_CANDIDATE; any other S11 branch/error stops and S19 is never authorized; no majority vote, no 1 MHz, no Q0/info/RL, and even three matching seeds are only an engineering testbed rather than a statistical or paper threshold claim.
acceptance: Give an exact field-level R03-to-S11/S19 mapping and identify every field that must or must not change.
Specify how each experiment will compile to exactly two serial cells ordered b5 then b2; flag any schema or governance risk Codex must test locally.
Both pressure decision contracts preserve the R03 ordered classes, thresholds, physical-validity and drain-validity gates while pointing only to their own experiment and analysis paths.
The R04 brief freezes both packages before any new result and accurately states the post-seed7 selection boundary and conditional S19 authorization stop rule.
No authorization, review receipt, finalization, result, or implementation code is created or modified.
Return a candidate-only PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES and explicit open items; do not claim tests were run.
requiredEvidence: Machine-readable field mapping for R03 versus S11/S19 invariants
